newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse says PTCL bond over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse says PTCL bond over-subscribed.

text.p: Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd's (PTCL) $150 million convertible bond has been heavily over-subscribed, the head of the Karachi Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
Arif Habib told Reuters that initial, unofficial figures showed the five-year issue had attracted orders worth $650 million.
"The bonds got a very good response abroad," he said, adding that this would boost confidence among foreign investors.
PTCL's 10-rupee shares opened 0.35 rupee up at 34.65 at the Karachi bourse on Thursday, dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said.

The bond has a six percent indicated coupon rate payable semi-annually with an issuer call option at par from February 2000. It also has a three-year investors' put option at a price to yield 150 basis points above the three-year U.S. treasuries.
The bond will be listed at the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and will be exchangeable into common stock listed in Pakistani bourses or into global depositary receipts.
The issue's joint lead managers are Nomura International plc and Union Bank of Switzerland (East Asia) Ltd.
